title: I vibecoded a music themed beat-em-up which features Pantera, Guns n Roses, Thin Lizzy, Radiohead and Smashing Pumpkins - try out FACEMELTERS
author: gints
selftext:
Hey all,

I love heavy/rock/alt music, I miss the 90s, and I love streets of rage. So I made Facemelters - a throwback 2D beat-em-up featuring Thin Lizzy, Guns, Pantera, Pumpkins and Radiohead.

Each stage is based on something from the band - their history, famous video clips, famous gigs, famous locations, classic lore. It's all very unserious but is my ode to the games I miss and the bands I love.

It's still Alpha and I am working on improving the overall gameplay and quality. Would love for you to give it a go. It's designed for a controller but works fine on a keyboard, and has auto scaling graphics and adjustable resolutions, but plays fine on mid spec PCs.

Disclaimer:

1. Obviously this game is not licensed as it contains songs from these bands. This is a freeware/hobby project only but I hope you get a smile or two.

Gints
